_readme: EXAMPLE plugin inventory for rule-of-30-session-builder.lua
(sgm-audio/sgm-studios-reapack -> Rule-of-30/).
Copy this file to 'plugin_inventory.json' in the SAME DIRECTORY as
rule-of-30-session-builder.lua. The builder looks there first, then in the
REAPER resource path.
WHAT IT ACTUALLY CONTROLS:
Only three tracks are 'smart' tracks and only they consult this file -
Kick In (Click)      -> category 'Dynamics', keywords {'Gate','Comp'}
Kick Out (Body)      -> category 'EQ',      keywords {'Kick','EQ'}
Kick Sub (40-60Hz)   -> category 'EQ',      keywords {'Sub','EQ'}
Every other track is built from fixed names and the stock preset library.
HOW A PLUG-IN IS CHOSEN (getBestPlugin):
1. The category must exist in by_category, and the list must not be empty.
2. Keywords are tried IN ORDER. For each keyword the whole list is scanned
in order. The first plug-in whose name CONTAINS the keyword wins.
3. The match is a plain case-insensitive SUBSTRING, not a word match.
4. If no keyword matches, the FIRST plug-in in the list is used.
5. The chosen plug-in is inserted with DEFAULT settings. No parameters are
written by the builder.
TWO GOTCHAS THAT WILL BITE YOU:
(a) SUBSTRING MATCHING. The keyword 'EQ' matches 'Ozone Equalizer' because
'Equalizer' contains 'eq'. The keyword 'Comp' matches 'V-Comp',
'Renaissance Compressor' and 'Dr. Comp'. The keyword 'Gate' matches
anything containing 'gate'. A keyword of 'Kick' or 'Sub' will match
nothing here, so those fall through to the next keyword.
(b) DO NOT LIST REAPER'S OWN 'ReaEQ' OR 'ReaGate' IN THE EQ / DYNAMICS
LISTS. The stock preset library (options 2-5) also inserts ReaEQ and
ReaGate on those same three kick tracks, and the preset code SKIPS any
plug-in that is already present - it does not write the parameters.
So if this file puts a bare ReaEQ on Kick Out, the preset's 40 Hz
high-pass is silently never applied and the track has an unconfigured
EQ on it. This is verified behaviour, not a theory.
Verified outcomes (measured with the builder's own mock-API harness):
EQ list contains 'ReaEQ'      -> Kick Out gets ReaEQ with NO band set
-> Kick Sub gets ReaEQ with NO band set
-> Kick In gets ReaGate with default
threshold (no -30 dB)
EQ list contains 'Linear Phase EQ' (or any non-ReaEQ EQ)
-> Kick Out gets Linear Phase EQ
(defaults, harmless) PLUS a properly
configured ReaEQ with HP 40 Hz
-> Kick Sub gets Linear Phase EQ PLUS a
properly configured ReaEQ with HP 30 Hz
-> Kick In gets the Dynamics plug-in PLUS
a properly configured ReaGate and ReaEQ
RESULT: With this file in place, Compact Mode builds the FULL 67-track
skeleton (67 + REAPER master = 68) instead of the 64-track version that
drops the three kick tracks.
CATEGORY NAMES: only 'EQ' and 'Dynamics' are read by the builder. You may
add other categories for your own tooling; they will be ignored.
PLUG-IN NAMES must match what REAPER reports for the plug-in exactly.
Check yours with FX/SGM_Plugin_Scanner.lua (in the sgm-reascripts repo),
which enumerates the installed plug-ins to CSV.
The lists below are a starting point for Waves Ultimate + Kilohearts Ultimate
+ iZotope Ozone. Replace the names with your own - the ORDER is what matters,
because the keyword loop scans the list from the top.
